entries.source: When work becomes too laborious, a strange whale comes to relax the Queen of Waves.
entries.text: 当工作变得过于繁重时，一只奇怪的鲸鱼会来放松波浪女王。

entries.source: Exiled by the construction of Dragheir, the ancient ice penguins now live near lava, forever dreaming of their homeland.
entries.text: 由于德拉盖尔的建造而被流放，古老的冰企鹅现在生活在熔岩附近，永远梦想着他们的家园。

entries.source: Gabriel and Lumisaros? Two brilliant friends who theorized about the perfect chair… after long reflection, they work standing up, on principle.
entries.text: 加布里埃尔和卢米萨罗斯？两位才华横溢的朋友，他们曾经理论化完美椅子的理念……经过长时间的思考，他们坚持原则，工作时站着。

entries.source: The beauty of black coral described in stories is, in truth, nothing but the sight of gaspoison deposits at the bottom of the sea.
entries.text: 故事中描述的黑珊瑚之美，实际上只是海底气体沉积物的景象。

entries.source: A chef compiles his frog-based recipes with rigor. In the marshes, one can hear him with a sharp and resounding “Croac Croac.”
entries.text: 一位厨师严格地整理他的青蛙菜谱。在沼泽中，人们可以听到他清脆响亮的“呱呱”声。

entries.source: Heraldesse is a telepath… often found drunk due to the backlash of her intoxicating powers. Telepathy must be practiced in moderation.
entries.text: 赫拉尔德塞是一位心灵感应者……她经常因为其迷人的能力反作用而醉倒。心灵感应必须适度练习。

entries.source: The octoflora knocks out its visitors… then recycles them into fertilizer, a solution to climate change.
entries.text: 八花击倒它的访客……然后将它们回收成肥料，这是应对气候变化的一个解决方案。

entries.source: Great lions know how to read. One of them is preparing a novel for the coming winter—if only he knew how to write.
entries.text: 伟大的狮子会阅读。其中一只正在为即将到来的冬天准备一本小说——如果它知道怎么写的话。

entries.source: Do not confuse a proper name with an event: Aurelia is not called Aurora.
entries.text: 不要将专有名词与事件混淆：奥雷莉娅不叫极光。

entries.source: The Primordial Codex? Shattered into a thousand pieces, simply because Nebula was too curious.
entries.text: 原始法典？因为星云太过好奇而碎成了千片。

entries.source: Slaying an abyssal creature releases a strange black smoke… smoking kills!
entries.text: 杀死深渊生物会释放出奇异的黑烟……吸烟有害！

entries.source: Some marine species have supposedly mutated just to enjoy the works of art on the surface.
entries.text: 据说有些海洋物种只是为了欣赏水面上的艺术作品而发生了变异。

entries.source: To avoid elemental imbalance and keep a sane mind, it is recommended to exhaust 5 spells or incantations per day.
entries.text: 为了避免元素失衡并保持清醒的头脑，建议每天施展 5 法术或咒语。

entries.source: Zayd must eat on schedule, otherwise he starts chewing whatever lies around.
entries.text: 扎伊德必须按时吃饭，否则他会开始啃周围的东西。

entries.source: The Master of Hues never dreams… but he paints his nightmares.
entries.text: 色彩大师从不做梦……但他会画出自己的噩梦。

entries.source: Those nightmares materialize in the real world as abyssal monsters.
entries.text: 那些噩梦以深渊怪物的形式在现实世界中显现。

entries.source: The pyramids of Shal’Zaar once produced electricity, but all stopped the day they collapsed.
entries.text: 沙尔扎尔的金字塔曾经产生电力，但在它们倒塌的那天全部停止了。

entries.source: The world created by the deities is a perfect sphere—who would ever believe in a flat one?
entries.text: 众神创造的世界是一个完美的球体——谁会相信它是平的呢？

entries.source: Vladislaus once got lost in his own manor of shifting rooms. He no longer leaves his living room, and Bernard, his butler, tends to him.
entries.text: 弗拉迪斯劳曾在自己不断变化的庄园里迷路。他不再离开自己的客厅，而他的管家伯纳德照顾着他。

entries.source: The burning willow is the only creature capable of resisting elemental corruption by purifying its habitat.
entries.text: 燃烧的柳树是唯一能够通过净化其栖息地来抵抗元素腐化的生物。

entries.source: The Natus are wild and territorial, organized into tribes with different cultures depending on their environment.
entries.text: 纳图斯是野性且有领地意识的生物，按环境不同组织成具有不同文化的部落。

entries.source: The Alphilans are fish-men who despise surface creatures, especially since the disappearance of their king.
entries.text: 阿尔菲兰人是鱼人，他们瞧不起地面生物，特别是在他们的国王消失之后。

entries.source: The Oniyx? Serious as ever… but only when it comes to work. Like the Inventor, if disturbed, he growls in hexadecimal.
entries.text: Oniyx？一如既往地严肃……但仅限于工作。就像发明家一样，如果被打扰，他会用十六进制咆哮。

entries.source: The Infernal City once used the flows of Mount Vulcain to forge the finest materials.
entries.text: 地狱之城曾利用伏尔坎山的熔流锻造最优质的材料。

entries.source: The ancient magical runes have lost their power, but they remain sacred to pilgrims.
entries.text: 古老的魔法符文已经失去力量，但它们仍然对朝圣者具有神圣意义。

entries.source: Mages must train their entire lives to strengthen their magic, using rare and precious catalysts.
entries.text: 法师必须终生训练以增强魔法，使用稀有且珍贵的催化剂。

entries.source: The TOX enhance an individual’s abilities, but they can cause dependency and dangerous side effects.
entries.text: TOX可以增强个体能力，但它们可能导致依赖性和危险的副作用。

entries.source: The nation of shadow is represented by the eye of the observer—always vigilant, always hidden.
entries.text: 影子之国由观察者之眼代表——始终警觉，始终隐藏。

entries.source: The nation of light is associated with the ear of the hunter, ever loyal even in the face of voices from the shadow.
entries.text: 光明之国与猎人的耳朵相关，即使面对来自阴影的声音也始终忠诚。

entries.source: The nation of nature is tied to the palm of the healer, gentle and attentive to every life.
entries.text: 自然之国与治疗者的手掌相连，温和且关注每一个生命。

entries.source: The nation of fire carries the fists of the worker, strong, relentless, always in motion.
entries.text: 火焰之国承载着工人的拳头，强大、 relentless，始终在运动。

entries.source: The nation of water is represented by the mouth of the negotiator, fluid and persuasive.
entries.text: 水之国由谈判者的嘴巴代表，灵活而有说服力。

entries.source: The nation of earth is linked to the nose of the seeker, able to sense the secrets buried beneath the rock.
entries.text: 大地之国与探寻者的鼻子相连，能够感知埋藏在岩石下的秘密。

entries.source: Lisa can do everything—except cook a meal. Faced with disaster, Frost forbids her from entering the kitchen.
entries.text: 丽莎能做一切事——除了做饭。面对灾难，弗罗斯特禁止她进入厨房。

entries.source: The Pack is a cult dedicated to Aeltheria, dwelling in the northeast of Emeldarion.
entries.text: 狼群是一个奉献于Aeltheria的教派，居住在Emeldarion的东北部。

entries.source: Before being King and Queen, light and shadow were just two childhood friends who grew up together before parting ways.
entries.text: 在成为国王和王后之前，光与影只是两个一起成长后又分开的童年朋友。

entries.source: In the north of Emeldarion, a cereal grows by pyrosynthesis: the Bleh. This land is ideal for pyromaniacs looking to turn to farming.
entries.text: 在埃梅尔达里昂的北部，有一种通过火光合成生长的谷物：布雷。这里的土地非常适合那些想通过农耕转向纵火癖的人。

entries.source: Dragons are intelligent and majestic creatures, yet capable of sulking for two centuries just because someone told them “no.”
entries.text: 龙是聪明而威严的生物，但却可能因为有人告诉它们“不”而闷闷不乐两百年。

entries.source: On Aelther, the pilgrim walking the sacred paths survives by feeding on caterpillars, juicy and honeyed.
entries.text: 在艾尔瑟，沿着神圣道路行走的朝圣者靠吃毛毛虫生存，那些毛毛虫又多汁又甜如蜂蜜。

entries.text: 坐在神圣石上的贤者为朝圣之旅增加了一个不必要的步骤，仅仅是为了欣赏朝圣者的反应。

entries.source: Your first Tox purchase of the game is refunded.
entries.text: 你在游戏中的第一次毒素购买将获得退款。

entries.source: 50% chance to regain the Phoenix passive once used.
entries.text: 有50%的几率再次获得已使用的凤凰被动效果。

entries.source: Start the game with the "Poison" passive.
entries.text: 游戏开始时拥有“中毒”被动。

entries.source: Start the game with the "Punching Bag" passive
entries.text: 游戏开始时获得“沙袋”被动

entries.source: 5% chance each turn to restore this card’s HP to maximum.
entries.text: 每回合有5%的几率将此卡的HP恢复至最大值。

entries.source: All of this card's abilities gain Echo (10%).
entries.text: 这张卡的所有技能获得回声（10%）。

entries.source: Each Tox rarity has exactly a 25% chance to be obtained.
entries.text: 每种Tox稀有度的获得几率正好为25%。

entries.source: When this card is permanently killed, it comes back to life with the "Random Metamorph" passive.
entries.text: 当此卡被永久消灭时，它会以“随机变形”被动效果复活。

entries.source: Applies "Random Metamorph" to all your other cards when this card is killed.
entries.text: 当此卡被消灭时，对你其他所有卡牌施加“随机变形”。

entries.source: Whenever a card on the field dies, this card's HP and max HP increase by (+<value1>)
entries.text: 每当场上的一张卡牌死亡时，该卡的生命值和最大生命值增加 (+<value1>)

entries.source: SPAM is a card dueling game: each player fights with 4 cards.
entries.text: SPAM 是一款卡牌对战游戏：每个玩家使用 4 张卡牌进行战斗。

entries.source: If you have no slots left for another passive, you can replace a passive or an ability already on your card.
entries.text: 如果你没有剩余的被动槽，可以替换掉你卡上已有的一个被动或技能。

entries.source: Warning: the cost increases with each reroll.
entries.text: 注意：每次重掷的费用都会增加。

entries.source: Later on, you'll be free to choose your targets. Thanks to the wide range of effects, you can target both allied and enemy cards.
entries.text: 稍后，你将可以自由选择目标。由于效果范围广，你可以选择友方和敌方卡牌。

entries.source: The shop offers Tox: passives you can buy to strengthen your cards. The higher your [CHANCE], the rarer they can be.
entries.text: 商店提供Tox：你可以购买的被动技能来强化你的卡牌。你的[CHANCE]越高，它们就越稀有。

entries.source: You already know how to play. Let's skip ahead to the next shop.
entries.text: 你已经知道怎么玩了。让我们直接跳到下一个商店。

entries.source: You may have noticed that your economy increases at the start of every turn. It depends on your cards' generation and the current turn.
entries.text: 你可能注意到，每回合开始时你的经济都会增加。这取决于你卡牌的产量和当前回合数。

entries.source: To win in SPAM, you must destroy all 4 enemy cards while protecting your own.
entries.text: 要在SPAM中获胜，你必须摧毁所有4张敌方卡牌，同时保护自己的卡牌。

entries.source: In this 2nd tutorial, we take a closer look at your cards and combat.
entries.text: 在本 2nd 教程中，我们将更详细地了解你的卡牌和战斗。

entries.source: There are plenty more passives and synergies to discover, so don't hesitate to explore your collection.
entries.text: 还有更多被动技能和协同效果等待发现，所以不要犹豫，去探索你的收藏吧。

entries.source: Let's start with the Fire Spirit.
entries.text: 让我们从火焰精灵开始。

entries.source: Each ability has a list of effects. For example, Breath of Flames attacks and grants you a Fire[FEU] bonus.
entries.text: 每个技能都有一系列效果。例如，火焰之息攻击并给予你一个Fire[FEU]加成。

entries.source:
Each ability also has three stats:
•<indent=1em>Accuracy: chance for an effect to succeed.</indent>
•<indent=1em>Critical: chance to hit or heal harder.</indent>
•<indent=1em>Critical Power: how much harder a critical is.</indent>
entries.text:
每个技能也有三个属性：
•<indent=1em>准确性：效果成功的几率。</indent>
•<indent=1em>暴击：命中或治疗更强的几率。</indent>
•<indent=1em>暴击强度：暴击造成的额外强度。</indent>

entries.source: Passives are automatic effects: they trigger on their own. Here are a few.
entries.text: 被动技能是自动效果：它们会自己触发。以下是几个示例。

entries.source: The Golden Boar just gained 1 Earth[TERRE] element point thanks to Punching Bag.
entries.text: 金猪刚刚通过沙袋获得了 1 土[TERRE] 元素点。

entries.source: Thanks to his Tenacity passive, Vladislaus withstood the attack and has 1 HP remaining.
entries.text: 凭借其坚韧不拔的被动技能，弗拉迪斯劳斯承受了攻击，剩余1点生命值。

entries.source: This bonus will let you deal more damage with your FIRE abilities.
entries.text: 这个奖励将让你的火属性技能造成更多伤害。

entries.source: Finally, some passives activate automatically at the start of a turn. End your turn to trigger them.
entries.text: 最后，有些被动技能在回合开始时会自动触发。结束你的回合以触发它们。

entries.source: At the start of its turn, Scorch's Ancient Healing passive restores a small amount of health.
entries.text: 在其回合开始时，Scorch 的古代治疗被动会恢复少量生命值。

entries.source: At the start of its turn, the Verdant Fruit Cruncher's Earthheart passive grants it an Earth[TERRE] bonus.
entries.text: 在其回合开始时，翠绿果实粉碎者的地心被动会给予其地[TERRE]加成。

entries.source: Let's see what your Spamtons are for.
entries.text: 让我们看看你的Spamtons有什么用。

entries.source: If you see a Tox that isn't useful to you but could benefit your opponent, use your one FREE ban to deny them that item. That Tox and all its rarity variants will be unavailable to both players.
entries.text: 如果你看到一个对你没用但可能对你的对手有利的Tox，使用你的一次免费禁用来阻止他们获取该物品。该Tox及其所有稀有度变体将对双方玩家都不可用。

entries.source: Buying a Tox takes two steps: select it (you can still cancel), then place it in any slot you like.
entries.text: 购买Tox分两步：选择它（你仍然可以取消），然后将其放入任意你喜欢的格子中。

entries.source: This bonus strengthens your Nature[NATURE] abilities.
entries.text: 这个奖励强化了你的Nature[NATURE]技能。

entries.source: SPAM features six different elements: Fire[FEU], Light[LUMIERE], Earth[TERRE], Nature[NATURE], Shadow[OMBRE], and Water[EAU]. Each card has an element, and so does each ability.
entries.text: SPAM 有六种不同的元素：火[FEU]、光[LUMIERE]、土[TERRE]、自然[NATURE]、暗[OMBRE] 和水[EAU]。每张卡都有一个元素，每个技能也都有元素。

entries.source: Some abilities ask you to choose a target.
entries.text: 有些技能会要求你选择一个目标。

entries.source: You can always cancel an action that requires a target with a right-click if needed.
entries.text: 如果需要，你总是可以通过右键取消需要目标的动作。

entries.source: You can always cancel an action that requires a target with the {0} button if needed.
entries.text: 如果需要，你总是可以使用 {0} 按钮取消需要目标的操作。

entries.source: Each card resists each element to a different degree: 20% Fire[FEU] resistance reduces Fire[FEU] damage by 20%.
entries.text: 每张卡牌对每种元素的抗性不同：20% 火[FEU] 抗性可将火[FEU] 伤害减少 20%。

entries.source: Each card can have a talent: a passive hidden from your opponent.
entries.text: 每张卡可以有一个天赋：一个对对手隐藏的被动效果。

entries.source: Others don't need a target. Use Windmill to see!
entries.text: 其他技能不需要目标。使用风车来看看吧！

entries.source: You just gained 1 more Nature[NATURE] element point.
entries.text: 你刚刚获得了1个额外的Nature[NATURE]元素点。

entries.source: After use, an ability must recharge: the number shows how many turns to wait.
entries.text: 使用后，技能必须充能：数字表示需要等待的回合数。

entries.source: At the end of your turn, all your cooldowns go down by 1.
entries.text: 在你的回合结束时，你所有的冷却时间减少 1。

entries.source: Once you've finished your actions, click End Turn to pass play to your opponent.
entries.text: 一旦你完成了所有操作，点击结束回合将游戏权交给对手。

entries.source: If nothing catches your eye, try your luck again by clicking Reroll. Warning: the cost increases each time.
entries.text: 如果没有任何东西吸引你，可以点击重掷再次尝试。注意：每次重掷的费用都会增加。

entries.source: If nothing interests you right now, end the shop phase and save up for the next one.
entries.text: 如果现在没有任何物品吸引你，可以结束商店阶段，并为下一次积攒资金。

entries.source: A ready ability you don't use stays available for later.
entries.text: 未使用的准备就绪技能将保留以备后用。

entries.source: With 2 Nature[NATURE] points, your attack goes from 10 to 12 damage.
entries.text: 拥有2个Nature[NATURE]点时，你的攻击伤害从10增加到12。

entries.source: Before buying, take a good look at each Tox: its price, its name, its rarity and what it does.
entries.text: 在购买之前，好好看看每张Tox：它的价格、名称、稀有度以及功能。

entries.source: Every two turns, the shop opens: there you spend the Spamtons earned by your cards, plus a bonus based on the current turn.
entries.text: 每两回合，商店会开放：在那里你可以花费你的卡片赚取的Spamtons，以及根据当前回合获得的额外奖励。

entries.source: This passive will no longer appear in your shop or your opponent's.
entries.text: 此被动技能将不再出现在你的商店或你的对手的商店中。

entries.source: Hover over your resources to see their generation details.
entries.text: 将鼠标悬停在你的资源上以查看其生成详情。

entries.source: Move the cursor over your resources to see their generation details.
entries.text: 将光标移到你的资源上以查看其生成详情。

entries.source: Each card has a Spamton generation value. It shows how many Spamtons that card generates each turn.
entries.text: 每张卡都有一个Spamton生成值。它显示该卡每回合生成多少Spamton。

entries.source: This one is perfect for your Fire[FEU] deck. Go ahead and buy it.
entries.text: 这张非常适合你的Fire[FEU]套牌。尽管购买吧。

entries.source: Good luck from here on. You're free to continue on your own now!
entries.text: 从这里开始祝你好运。你现在可以自由地继续游戏了！

entries.source: How about a quick tour of the menu with me?
entries.text: 要不要跟我快速浏览一下菜单？

entries.source: You've seen the essentials! End your turn to finish this first tutorial.
entries.text: 你已经了解了基础内容！结束你的回合来完成第一个教程。

entries.source: Now take aim: click my card to attack it.
entries.text: 现在瞄准：点击我的卡片进行攻击。

entries.source: Well done! Look at what Windmill just earned you.
entries.text: 干得好！看看风车刚刚为你赢得了什么。

entries.source: Attack with Conflagration to see my passives in action!
entries.text: 用大火攻击，看看我的被动技能如何发挥作用！

entries.source: And now it's my turn to attack!
My turn! Watch what my passives do at the start of my turn.
entries.text: 轮到我了！看看我的被动技能在回合开始时会做什么。

entries.source: Now choose where to put this Tox on your card.
entries.text: 现在选择将这个毒素放到你的哪张卡上。

entries.source: Welcome back! Shall we pick up where we left off?
entries.text: 欢迎回来！我们要从上次停下的地方继续吗？

entries.source: Alright! If you change your mind, click on me in the Tutorial tab under Play.
entries.text: 好的！如果你改变主意，可以在“游戏”下的“教程”标签中点击我。

entries.source: Hello, and welcome to SPAM! I'm Subject 042.
entries.text: 你好，欢迎来到 SPAM！我是主题 042。

entries.source: Is this your first time here? If you like, I can show you how to play, then give you a tour of the menu.
entries.text: 这是你第一次来这里吗？如果你愿意，我可以教你怎么玩，然后带你浏览菜单。

entries.source: Great! Let's start with the tutorial: three short matches to learn the basics.
entries.text: 太好了！让我们从教程开始：三场简短的比赛来学习基础知识。

entries.source: To open the tutorial, click Play!
entries.text: 要打开教程，请点击“游戏”!

entries.source: Start with 1. Basics. See you there!
entries.text: 从1. 基础开始，到那里见!

entries.source: Well played! Let's continue with 2. Fight.
entries.text: 玩的很好！让我们继续2. 战斗。

entries.source: Well done! Last step: 3. Store, to learn how to spend your Spamtons.
entries.text: 干得不错！最后一步：3. 商店，学习如何花费你的Spamton。

entries.source: Before we start: which language would you like to play in? You can change it later in Settings.
entries.text: 在开始之前：你希望使用哪种语言进行游戏？你可以稍后在设置中更改。

entries.source: No thanks, I know the game
entries.text: 不用了，谢谢，我已经懂这个游戏了

entries.source: Alright, I'll let you get to it! The tutorial is waiting for you in Play, with my avatar as a reward.
entries.text: 好吧，我让你去做吧！教程在“游戏”中等你，作为奖励还有我的头像。

entries.source: Have fun, and see you soon!
Welcome back! Let's pick up the tutorial with 2. Fight.
entries.text: 欢迎回来！让我们从教程的2. 战斗继续。

entries.source: Welcome back! Only one step left to finish the tutorial: 3. Store.
entries.text: 欢迎回来！教程只剩下一步就完成了：3. 商店。

entries.source: Well done, you've finished the tutorial! To celebrate, I'm giving you my avatar.
entries.text: 干得好，你已经完成了教程！为了庆祝，我送你我的头像。

entries.source: Well done, you've finished the tutorial! You now know all the basics to play.
entries.text: 干得好，你已经完成了教程！你现在已经掌握了所有基本玩法。

entries.source: A duplicate is never wasted: it unlocks a talent for that card.
entries.text: 重复的卡永远不会浪费：它会为该卡解锁一个天赋。
点击打开一个新的宝珠。

entries.source: You have one left: this time, it's your turn to open it!
entries.text: 你还剩一个：这一次，由你来打开它！

entries.source: You'll earn an orb every level, and the Shop has some too.
entries.text: 每升一级，你都能获得一个宝珠，商店里也有一些。

entries.source: Let's take a look at your cards. Click Collection.
entries.text: 让我们看看你的卡牌。点击收藏。

entries.source: Here's your collection: your six Spirits, one per element, and the cards from your orbs.
entries.text: 这是你的收藏：你拥有六位元素灵，每个元素一位，以及你从宝珠中获得的卡牌。

entries.source: Right-click a card to take a closer look.
entries.text: 右键点击一张牌以仔细查看。

entries.source: Point at a card and press the {0} button to take a closer look.
entries.text: 将光标指向一张牌并按 {0} 按钮以仔细查看。

entries.source: You'll find everything here: its abilities, talents, styles and even who drew it.
entries.text: 你可以在这里找到所有信息：它的能力、天赋、风格，甚至是谁绘制的。

entries.source: Talents are passives hidden from your opponent. You pick the card's talent here.
entries.text: 天赋是对手看不到的被动技能。你可以在这里选择牌的天赋。

entries.source: To play, you need a deck of 4 cards. Click Add deck to create yours.
entries.text: 要进行游戏，你需要一个包含4张牌的牌组。点击“添加牌组”以创建你的牌组。

entries.source: You can pick it here, in Customization, whenever you like.
entries.text: 你可以随时在自定义中选择它。

entries.source: Click 4 cards to add them. Clicking a card a second time removes it.
entries.text: 点击4张牌以添加它们。再次点击同一张牌则会移除它。

entries.source: Add the 4 cards from your starter orb: click each of them.
entries.text: 从你的初始宝珠中添加4张牌：点击每一张。

entries.source: And there's your first deck! You can rename or edit it whenever you like.
entries.text: 这就是你的第一副牌！你可以随时重命名或编辑它。

entries.source: Time to try it out! Click Play.
entries.text: 现在试试吧！点击“开始游戏”。

entries.source: Casual: relaxed matches, perfect for getting started. Click it.
entries.text: 休闲：轻松对战，非常适合入门。点击它。

entries.source: Ranked: here, your rank is on the line. This mode unlocks after 3 Casual matches.
entries.text: 排名：在这里，你的排名将受到影响。此模式在完成3场休闲赛后解锁。

entries.source: Training: test a deck against the AI, at your own pace.
entries.text: 训练：对战AI，按照自己的节奏测试套牌。

entries.source: Tutorial: go over the basics again whenever you like.
entries.text: 教程：随时复习基础知识。

entries.source: Your new deck is waiting for you here, ready for battle.
entries.text: 你新的套牌在这里等你，准备战斗。

entries.source: To get back to the home screen, just click the logo.
entries.text: 要返回主界面，只需点击标志。

entries.source: Start your first Casual match whenever you like. See you right after!
entries.text: 随时开始你的第一场休闲赛。赛后见！

entries.source: Let's explore the menu: this is where you earn cards, build your decks and find opponents.
entries.text: 让我们来探索菜单：这里是你获取卡牌、构建牌组和寻找对手的地方。

entries.source: This little number shows how many orbs you can open. Click it!
entries.text: 这个小数字显示你可以开启多少宝珠。点击它！

entries.source: An orb holds cards. No one knows how to make them anymore: each one is precious.
entries.text: 宝珠里有卡牌。没人知道如何再制造它们：每个都很珍贵。

entries.source: This one is special: you get to choose its element. Which one catches your eye?
entries.text: 这个很特别：你可以选择它的属性。哪个吸引了你的注意？

entries.source: Great choice! Click Open orb, I can't wait to see what's inside.
entries.text: 很棒的选择！点击打开宝珠，我迫不及待想看看里面有什么。

entries.source: Keep clicking the orb until it opens. I love this part!
entries.text: 继续点击宝珠直到它打开。我喜欢这一部分！

entries.source: Now click each reward to reveal it.
entries.text: 现在点击每个奖励来揭示它。

entries.source: Each reward shows what it brings you: a new card, a new talent or a new skin.
entries.text: 每个奖励都会显示它带给你的内容：一张新卡、一项新天赋或一款新皮肤。

entries.source: Nice first match! The experience you earn raises your level, and each level gives you an orb.
entries.text: 精彩的第一场比赛！你获得的经验会提升等级，每升一级都会获得一个宝珠。

entries.source: Missions earn you rewards too. Click on them.
entries.text: 任务也能获得奖励。点击它们。

entries.source: Daily, weekly or monthly: every mission you complete earns you a reward.
entries.text: 每日、每周或每月：你完成的每个任务都会获得奖励。

entries.source: This one is complete: click it to collect your reward.
entries.text: 这个已完成：点击它领取你的奖励。

entries.source: The bell keeps a history of your notifications, in case you miss one.
entries.text: 铃铛会保存你的通知历史，以防你错过任何通知。

entries.source: Your Crystals are shown here. They're used to buy orbs.
entries.text: 你的水晶显示在这里。它们用于购买宝珠。

entries.source: Speaking of which, let's take a look at the Shop.
entries.text: 说到这个，让我们看看商店吧。

entries.source: Welcome to the Shop, my favorite place!
entries.text: 欢迎来到商店，我最喜欢的地方！

entries.source: Two currencies here: Crystals, earned by playing, and Spam, the premium currency.
entries.text: 这里有两种货币：水晶，通过游戏获得；以及Spam，高级货币。

entries.source: Orbs: new cards, for Crystals or Spam.
entries.text: 宝珠：新的卡牌，用水晶或Spam购买。

entries.source: Draw: 4 cards sold individually, refreshed regularly. Remember to check back!
entries.text: 抽取：4张单独出售的卡牌，定期刷新。记得常回来查看！

entries.source: Skins: new styles for your cards. Same card, new look.
entries.text: 皮肤：为你的卡片提供新风格。相同的卡片，全新的外观。

entries.source: Showcase: the latest arrivals, including the Premium Pass.
entries.text: 展示区：最新到货商品，包括高级通行证。

entries.source: Now you know the essentials! Let's go back to Play.
entries.text: 现在你已经了解了基本内容！让我们回到游戏中。

entries.source: I'll let you discover the rest on your own. There's still plenty to explore!
entries.text: 我会让你自己去发现其余的内容。还有很多可以探索！

entries.source: Have fun, and see you soon!
Are you still there? If you like, we can pick up where we left off.
entries.text: 你还在吗？如果你愿意，我们可以从上次停下的地方继续。

entries.source: No problem! We'll pick this up next time.
Who dares challenge me on my own territory?!
entries.text: 谁敢在我的地盘上挑战我？！

entries.source: Kill him quickly, or your whole team will share his fate.
entries.text: 快点杀了他，否则你的整个队伍都将遭遇同样的命运。
